perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: On 2026-09-18 the FDA granted full approval to Lilly's Inluriyo in combination with Verzenio for ESR1-mutated ER+/HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer after endocrine therapy progression.
The approval is a fresh portfolio execution signal outside Lilly's metabolic franchise and follows completion of the AtaiBeckley acquisition on September 11, broadening neuroscience optionality.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Regulatory approval converts clinical evidence into a commercializable oncology combination, but revenue contribution depends on uptake, eligible population and competitive positioning.
AtaiBeckley adds pipeline optionality rather than near-term proven economics; integration and clinical execution remain separate tests.

sources.use: fresh regulatory and portfolio execution evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer primary-source acquisition focused on post-prior-run regulatory and portfolio execution
